title: Dart entrypoint lacks @pragma('vm:entry-point')
message: widgetMain() is declared but not annotated; the Flutter documentation requires the annotation so a non-main entrypoint is not tree-shaken in AOT builds (observed with a release build of an isolated sample on Flutter 3.32.0: the unannotated function was absent from libapp.so).
fix: Add @pragma('vm:entry-point') to the declaration of widgetMain().
